timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Rules go stale. Attackers adapt. That's why we hunt.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What's the difference between hunting and alerting?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Alerting waits for a rule to fire. Hunting actively searches for compromise before any alert.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: How do I start a hunt?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Hypothesis first. Ground it in threat intel and MITRE ATT&CK, then validate with KQL.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Blue and red teams? What about purple?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Blue defends, red attacks. Purple runs both together to prove what's detected.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Measure against CMMI. Initial to optimizing. Hunting maturity comes late.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Playbooks in Logic Apps automate response at machine speed.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Detection engineering. Develop, tune, test, deploy, then review as tactics change.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Exactly. Every good hunt can ship a new rule.
